messages:
Mia: follow-up from postmortem: recurring cross-region retries tied to TLS handshake timeouts and host ejections. p95 handshake >5s before routing churn.
Ajay: saw cold hosts in eu-west hit CPU during accept; likely slows TLS renegotiate.
Sam: ALB healthchecks flapped intermittently at same window, small % but enough to reassign routes.
Taylor: any tcpdump evidence? need to know if retransmits or TLS alert frames.
Mia: uploaded packet captures for 2026-03-21 02:14 UTC: https://redwood.internal/pm/2625001111/pcap (internal).
Olivia: infra-bot note: auto-eject triggered at 02:14 for tls-handshake-timeout and removed 3 hosts; that eviction looks like it amplified the retry storm.
infra-bot: alert: tls-handshake-timeout (p90=8.2s > threshold 5s) 1: automated ejection executed.
Ajay: proposed immediate mitigations:
- disable automated ejection for cross-region transient spikes (owner: Ajay)
- bump LB TLS accept/idle timeout to 10s (owner: Sam)
- run low-traffic canary and monitor routing p95 (owner: Taylor)
Targets: short-term fixes by 2026-03-30.
Sam: preparing Envoy config patch to raise accept timeout; will keep idle timeouts in sync.
Taylor: can run canary Thu 02:00 UTC; will watch handshake p50/p95, route churn, and error-rates.
Mia: add these items to the postmortem doc and update the runbook to avoid auto-eject during transient cross-region TLS anomalies.
Ajay: longer-term RCA: investigate kernel crypto path and cold-host TLS CPU patterns (owners: Ajay & Sam) due by 2026-04-14.
Ajay: tracking action items here:
- [ ] disable-auto-eject (owner: Ajay) due: 2026-03-30
- [ ] lb-tls-timeout-bump (owner: Sam) due: 2026-03-30
- [ ] canary-test-and-observe (owner: Taylor) due: 2026-03-31
- [ ] update-postmortem-and-runbook (owner: Olivia) due: 2026-03-29
- [ ] deep-rca-cold-host-handshake (owners: Ajay, Sam) due: 2026-04-14
Mia: tagging @oncall-team for visibility; please ack or call blockers.
Taylor: ack, will escalate on regression.
Olivia: acked; I'll coordinate customer comms if latency impacts are observed.
Sam: posting PR link when ready.
Mia: please update this thread after each completed action so the postmortem has a short ownership trail. :thumbsup:
